title: Two sessions read the same official pages on 2026-11-19 — where the artifacts agree
policy: computed from both namespaces' published JSON with no manual entry; a disagreement is published as a disagreement with each side's file named, and no peer file is edited to make the comparison clean

injury_report.practice_vocab_note: the official vocabulary is mixed-case in the source itself — the byte-exact 2026-11-18 capture holds 83 'Full Participation in Practice', 82 'Limited Participation in Practice' and 77 'Did Not Participate In Practice'. This desk pins those strings verbatim; a delta panel built on title-cased values would report casing changes as availability changes.

standings.note: the peer read exposes conference and division per club; this desk's read of the same page could not establish the split-column order because the rendered header was un-substituted, so those fields are omitted here and carried by the peer artifact under its own read date

week11_slate.note: the desk records no venue of its own; the peer read transcribed 12 of 13 from the schedule page's stadium links and cross-checked Thursday's against the game centre, which is how the label disagreement surfaced

peer_flags.finding: IND@HOU venue discrepancy between two official NFL surfaces: the Week-11 schedule page's stadium/hotel link reads 'NRG Stadium', while the official game centre Game Info reads 'Reliant Stadium' (HOUSTON, TX).
peer_flags.action: Game centre treated as authoritative per the brief; discrepancy flagged for owner review.

peer_flags.finding: The full 32-club Week-11 injury report was not recounted live this session; 10 clubs (IND, HOU, PIT, PHI, AZ, KC, BAL, CAR, TB, DET) were transcribed in full (111 rows). Row counts for the other 22 clubs are not asserted.
peer_flags.action: Scope limit disclosed; full recount recommended via the peer scheduled collector.

peer_flags.finding: The fetch tool exposes no exact clock time; the injury read is dated 2026-11-19 but no precise timestamp is claimed.
peer_flags.action: Recorded as a dated read; clock-time precision requires the peer timestamped collector.

peer_flags.finding: No official NFL source publishes betting lines, odds or closing prices; all market/price fields remain blank by policy.
peer_flags.action: Market/price columns intentionally blank; blocks residual/CLV/ROI.

peer_flags.finding: Houston's official depth chart is published as a static image (not machine-readable); it is not transcribed by eye.
peer_flags.action: HOU depth rows left blank; needs an authorized structured source.

peer_flags.finding: Lions Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed were 'Out' in the Week-10 report but appear practicing (full/limited) with blank game-status in the Week-11 report read 2026-11-19.
peer_flags.action: Designation change recorded; confirms designations are a timestamped series, not a static level.

peer_flags.finding: Aidan Hutchinson (DET) placed on Reserve/Injured on 11/18/2026 — a significant defensive player, relevant to DET availability.
peer_flags.action: Recorded in the reserve-list table; no value inferred.

peer_flags.finding: Venue for 12 of 13 Week-11 fixtures was transcribed from the schedule page's own stadium links, not yet from each official game centre.
peer_flags.action: TNF venue verified from game centre; remaining 12 flagged for game-centre reads.

peer_flags.finding: Standings reflect records through Week 10 with byes; games-played vary by team (9 or 10 games), so per-team game counts are not uniform.
peer_flags.action: Arithmetic reconciles (149 W = 149 L, 150 games); no per-team normalization applied.

peer_flags.finding: No official snap-count or actual-starter feed exists in the verified corpus; this blocks replacement-depth, deficiency and availability-graph features.
peer_flags.action: Features stay blocked until an authorized Game Book / snap-count join is available.

headline.reading: two sessions, one official page, same day: 109 of 111 injury rows agree on every field, and all 10 per-club row counts the peer published match this desk's. 192 of 192 standings fields agree, the reserve ledger reconciles at 25 of 25 rows, and 13 of 13 Week 11 fixtures appear in both. The 2 injury differences and the venue label disagreement are published below rather than reconciled silently.
